content.text:
I fixed the wrong due dates, and `npm test` now passes (1 of 1).

**Cause:** `parseDate` in `src/dates.js` passed the month straight to `Date.UTC`, which counts months from 0. Every parsed date landed one month late, so an invoice issued Jan 30 with 14-day terms came out due 2026-03-16 instead of 2026-02-13.

**Fix:** `Date.UTC(y, m, d)` is now `Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)`.

`reportMonth` in `src/report.js` also calls `parseDate`, so the monthly revenue report labels were probably off by one month too. That should now be fixed as well. No test covers `reportMonth`, so I didn't check it. If you exported or filed any past reports, look at their month labels.
